subject: Econ + Security alignment: procurement roadmap and next steps after demo
messages:
From: Liam Turner <liam.turner@orionhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — summary + procurement path

Hi Karthik — thanks again for today's demo. Quick recap from our side and where we need help: 

- Economic buyer: Priya (VP, Platform) will sign off on TCO and SLA.
- Security & compliance: we need SOC 2 summary, encryption at rest details, and confirmation on data retention and deletion hooks for PHI de-identification flows.
- Procurement: standard terms look OK but procurement will request an addendum for data processing and breach notification timelines.
- Decision timeline: if security answers and pricing are aligned, target procurement review week of 6/21, exec signoff by end of June.

Can you confirm owners on your side for each item and share a simple mutual action plan we can put in our procurement tracker? Also, example SSO/SCIM docs would be helpful — we run Okta.

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood provides SOC 2 summary + encryption and retention notes (by EOD 6/6).
2) Redwood pulls together a short MAP with owners and dates (by 6/8).
3) We schedule a 30-min procurement Q&A with Priya & procurement team (availability next week).

Thanks, and again the demo made a strong case for reduced inference cost — that resonated with Priya.

-Liam
Director of Engineering, Orion Health


---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@orionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — summary + procurement path

Liam — great to connect, appreciate the clear ask. Putting owners and a short plan below. I've also attached the one-page SOC 2 summary and a draft MAP.

Owners (Redwood):
- Security & SOC2 / encryption / retention: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — will provide the SOC 2 summary and a short Q&A doc for your security team.
- Procurement & commercial MAP: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — will draft the mutual action plan and respond to contract-addendum items.
- Technical onboarding / SSO & integration: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — I will share an Okta/SCIM quickstart and sample config.

Committed dates:
- SOC 2 one-pager + encryption notes: by 2027-06-06 EOD PT.
- Draft MAP (owners + target dates): by 2027-06-08.
- Procurement Q&A: propose Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–10:30 PT (please confirm availability).

Notes on the technical/security items you flagged:
- Encryption at rest: models and customer data at rest are encrypted with AES-256; keys can be managed via customer KMS in the Private deployment (we'll include KMS integration notes in the doc).
- Data retention & deletion: we support per-customer retention windows with on-demand deletion APIs; for PHI we can agree to a 30‑day purge policy in writing — Marissa will include the API endpoints and audit/logging behavior.
- SSO/SCIM: single-tenant SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning supported; sample Okta metadata and mapping are in the quickstart.

I attached two stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and mutual-action-plan-orion.xlsx. Let me know if you want those as Drive links instead.

Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference


---

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@orionhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — summary + procurement path

Thanks Karthik — received the SOC 2 summary and MAP. A couple quick clarifications before procurement schedules the review: 

1) For data residency: our production PHI processing must remain in us-east-1. Can you confirm whether Redwood Hosted can pin region for data residency, or whether we need a Private deployment to guarantee that?
2) For audit/logging: we need an exportable audit log on request (CSV/JSON) with 90-day retention by default; can you confirm format and latency of log exports?

If you can add short answers to the MAP for these two items, procurement can schedule the review on 6/21. Regarding the procurement Q&A slot, Tue 6/8 10am PT works for me and Priya (we'll invite procurement).

Best,
Priya
VP, Platform — Orion Health


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@orionhealth.com>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — summary + procurement path

Hi Priya / Liam — thanks for the quick read. Quick answers below and I'll append both into the MAP and send an updated sheet after the Q&A: 

1) Data residency: Redwood Hosted can pin region for customer data in most cases; for legally binding guarantees (and if you require an explicit clause in the contract), we recommend Redwood Private. For your use case (PHI), we can operate in us-east-1 under Hosted and provide contractual language that limits processing to that region — happy to route this to Legal if you prefer an addendum.

2) Audit/logging: We provide an exportable audit log (JSON/CSV) via our Console export API. Default retention on Hosted is 90 days (configurable as part of Dedicated/Private packages). Export requests are typically available within 15 minutes; for bulk exports we provide a signed S3 export link (24–48 hours depending on size). We'll include example export files in the MAP.

Finally, procurement Q&A confirmed for Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–10:30 PT — you'll get a calendar invite from Ben.

I'll update the MAP with the residency and audit entries and re-share by EOD. If you want any additional compliance artifacts (penetration test summary, encryption key rotation policy), let me know and I'll add to the packet.

—Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
